rule.min_credits: At least 'min_credits' credits from eligible courses.
rule.all_children: Every child requirement must be met.
rule.any_child: Any one child requirement must be met.
rule.course_list: Lists courses but the source states no required number, so it is shown, not evaluated.
rule.not_tracked: Cannot be checked from a list of courses (GPA, residency, ...).

_format.eligible courses: Courses in 'courses', plus courses matching any of 'filters'. A min_credits/min_courses rule with neither counts every course.
_format.filters: Each filter matches on subject, course number range, and/or Gen Ed tag (all given fields must match).
_format.min_grade / allocation_group: Inherited by children unless overridden. Within one allocation group a course counts toward only one requirement.

children.name: 120 total credits
children.description: No bachelor's degree is awarded with fewer than 120 credits.

children.name: 15 upper-level credits
children.description: At least 15 credits in courses numbered 300 or above, including at least 12 credits in the major field.

children.name: 30 credits in residence
children.description: At least 30 credits must be taken at UMD, normally the final 30.

children.name: Cumulative GPA of 2.0
children.description: A minimum cumulative 2.0 GPA is required for graduation.

children.name: GPA of 2.0 in major courses
children.description: A minimum 2.0 GPA across all courses used to satisfy major requirements.

university.name: General Education
university.description: Gen Ed courses may also count toward major requirements and may not be taken Pass-Fail.

children.name: Academic Writing
children.description: Must be attempted by 30 credits and completed by 60 credits.

children.name: Mathematics
children.description: Must be attempted by 30 credits and completed by 60 credits.

children.name: Natural Sciences
children.description: Two courses, one of which must include a lab.

children.name: Scholarship in Practice
children.description: One of the two must be outside the student's major requirements (not checked yet).

children.name: Big Question
children.description: Two of the eight Distributive Studies courses must be Big Question courses.

children.name: Diversity
children.description: Diversity courses may also count in a Distributive Studies category.

children.name: One Understanding Plural Societies and one Cultural Competence course

program.name: Information Science Major
program.description: Students must earn a C- or better in all major requirements. 57 credits total.

children.name: Benchmark Courses
children.description: MATH115 (or higher). Other courses exist that fulfill the INST126 requirement; check with an advisor.

children.name: Major Electives
children.description: 15 credits (five courses) of upper-level (300-400 level) INST electives. Courses used for the core don't count again. Non-INST upper-level courses may count through the program's elective proposal form (not tracked).

children.name: Cognate Areas (optional)
children.description: Instead of general electives, students may focus their major electives in one cognate area. Cognate courses are also INST electives, so they count toward Major Electives too.

children.name: Cybersecurity and Privacy
